send.summary: Writes a message in chat: to whoever launched the script, or to a given target.
params: optional: a player, or a **list** of players
send.returns: the message, so the call can be slipped in the middle of an expression.
examples: text.send(player, text.format('rb watch out', 'w  something went wrong'));
send.note: The target takes a list as it is: `entity.player('all')` goes in with no loop around it.

format.summary: Builds formatted text. Every piece is `'style text'`, where the style is a run of letters.
params: the pieces, in order. Colours: `w` white, `y` yellow, `m` magenta, `r` red, `c` cyan, `l` light green, `t` blue, `f` dark grey, `g` grey, `d` gold, `p` purple, `n` dark red, `q` dark cyan, `e` dark green, `v` dark blue, `k` black, `#rrggbb` exact. Styles: `i` italic, `b` bold, `u` underlined, `s` struck through, `o` obfuscated
format.returns: `text` — formatted text, usable everywhere a message goes.
examples: text.format('rb Warning', 'w  the area is unstable');

// an action attached to the piece before it
text.format('c click here', '!/say hello', '^g runs a command');
format.note: A piece starting with a symbol attaches an action to the piece before it: `^` text on hover, `!` runs a command, `?` writes it in chat, `@` opens an address, `&` copies to the clipboard.

signatures: title(targets, type, text, fade_in, stay, fade_out)
params: a player or a list of players
what to write, plain or formatted
optional: the three times, in ticks

hud.summary: A line of text above the hotbar, which stays there.
params: a player or a list of players
what to show; `null` removes the line
optional, in ticks: **without it the line stays**, there is no hidden default
hud.returns: `num` — how many players were touched; with one argument, the line they are seeing or `null`.
examples: text.hud(player, 'ores found: ' + found);        // stays until you change it
text.hud(player, 'unstable area', 60);           // three seconds, then it goes
hud.note: It works on any client, with nothing installed: it is the action bar, resent before it fades. Three consequences — there is only one line, it shares the space with everything else writing there, and the position is not up for choice. A duration of zero or less is an error, not "disappears at once": whoever writes it has almost always miscomputed an interval.
